description: HR-92 is the Regional Transport Office for the Radaur sub-division located in the Yamuna Nagar district of Haryana. This office facilitates vehicle registration, driving licenses, and other transport-related services at the sub-divisional level under the authority of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate. It serves as a decentralized hub to handle the growing transport needs of the Radaur region.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Radaur, Yamuna Nagar District, Haryana
